fullDescription: A high-intensity, dark-themed 'emergency' design system featuring a 'hot' red-to-orange gradient palette. Utilizing editorial typography with Clash Grotesk and Satoshi, the aesthetic combines technical precision with vibrant urgency. Key features include a seismic grid background, scanline overlays, pulsing status indicators, and heavy atmospheric glow effects. Optimized for real-time monitoring, security dashboards, fintech alert systems, and critical logistics tracking. The design uses high-contrast accessibility patterns with a focus on 'priority' categorization.

structured.summary: Gising! Design System: A bold, high-contrast dark mode interface for critical monitoring. It features a technical 'seismic' background grid, vibrant red/orange accents, and sophisticated glow-heavy UI components. Typography is a mix of geometric grotesque and modern sans-serif. Navigation is handled via a persistent bottom bar, while information density is managed through categorized cards with quick-action micro-interactions.

style.description: The style is 'Techno-Urgency'. Typography: 'Clash Grotesk' for headings (bold, tight letter-spacing) and 'Satoshi' for utility/body text (highly legible). Color Palette: Deep black-red background (#0a0608), rich card backgrounds (#130b0e), and a primary 'Heat' gradient (#ff2d55 to #ff6a00). Accents include Safety Green (#22c55e) and Warning Yellow (#f59e0b). Visual language includes radial glow spots, linear scanline animations, and pulsing rings.
style.prompt: Create a design system using a dark mode palette: background #0a0608, cards #130b0e, inputs #1a0d11, and borders #2e1520. Use a primary gradient from #ff2d55 to #ff6a00 for CTAs and branding. Typography: Headings in 'Clash Grotesk' (700 weight, -0.05em spacing), body in 'Satoshi'. Apply a 'seismic grid' background using 28px linear gradients at rgba(255,45,85,0.04). All buttons must have a 0.12s active scale transform (0.97). Add a global scanline effect: a 2px horizontal line with a red-tinted linear gradient moving vertically every 6 seconds. Cards should have a 1px border (#2e1520) and a subtle 24px-48px shadow with 0.6 opacity.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical-scrolling mobile-first layout with a persistent header and footer, utilizing high-density data chips and categorized lists.

prompts.prompt: The header includes a left-aligned 26px font-size title with a gradient-colored exclamation mark and a 12px muted subtitle. Opposite is a 42px notification button with a red badge. Below, a full-width search bar with 1.5px borders, 10px icon padding, and a 14px font-size placeholder.

A horizontal row of flex-growing chips. Each chip is #130b0e with a 1px border, containing a 22px bold number and a 10px uppercase label with 0.06em tracking. The 'Alert' chip must have a pulsing text color of #ff2d55.

Vertical list grouped by 'Attention' and 'Confirmed' sections. Section labels are 10px uppercase text in #6b3345 with 0.12em spacing. Each list item is a 2-column card: left col contains a 48px circular avatar with a status dot (11px diameter, 2px border); right col contains name, badge (e.g., 'SOS' or 'Safe'), location icon, and relative timestamp. Below the info, an action row contains 36px square icon buttons and one primary long-form button.

Secondary actions are 36px square buttons with 10% opacity backgrounds matching their icon color (green/red/orange). The primary button is a full-width gradient bar with a shield icon. A 56px Floating Action Button (FAB) sits at bottom-right (bottom: 90px, right: 20px) using the primary red/orange gradient.

A fixed 1px top-border footer with 4 tab items. Active item uses #ff2d55, inactive uses #6b3345. Labels are 10px uppercase with 0.04em tracking below 22px icons. Overall height is approx 80px including safe area padding.

special_ui_components.description: An avatar with three expanding, fading concentric rings to denote high urgency.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement a 68px center icon container with a linear gradient (#ff2d55 to #ff6a00). Behind it, place three absolute-positioned 1.5px borders (rings) that scale from 1.0 to 2.2 and fade from 0.55 to 0 opacity using a 2s ease-out loop with 0.65s staggered delays.

special_ui_components.description: A pill-shaped indicator showing active monitoring status.
special_ui_components.prompt: A container with background rgba(255,45,85,0.1) and 1px border. Inside, a 8px #ff2d55 circle with a 16px blur glow, utilizing a 'blink' animation (1.4s ease-in-out). Text is 10.5px bold, uppercase, #ff2d55 with 0.1em tracking.

special_ui_components.description: A global CRT-style flicker effect for technical depth.
special_ui_components.prompt: A fixed position div (width: 100%, height: 2px) with a horizontal linear-gradient from transparent to rgba(255,45,85,0.08) to transparent. Animate this div from translateY(-100%) to translateY(100vh) over a 6-second linear infinite loop.

structured.special_notes: MUST use 'Clash Grotesk' for any numerical data and titles to maintain the technical look. MUST include the radial glow (radial-gradient) in the background to prevent the dark mode from feeling flat. DO NOT use standard blue for links; use #ff2d55 with a glow effect. ALL interactive elements MUST have a scale-down animation on click.
